O cetate de piatră albă pe o creastă verde, sub un cer albastru, cu norul în vale. Camera vede ~5° în sus și ~63° în jos, deci cetatea nu se privește din piață, se urcă și apoi se privește de sus: pornim din Piața Sacră între ziduri de granit, urcăm pe treptele Drumului Incaș cu defileul căzând pe dreapta, trecem prin Poarta Soarelui și coborâm creasta cu prăpastie de ambele părți — cetatea sub roți, Huayna Picchu crescând în față — cădem cascada de terase, traversăm podul de frânghie care se afundă sub masă, atingem râul cu trenul pe mal, urcăm serpentinele cu autobuzul venind spre noi și intrăm în cetate pe cornișa Podului Incaș. Sens antiorar, defileul pe dreapta (în exteriorul buclei; terasele și cetatea în interior). Traseul de aici e cel din Track15.tscn, trecut prin ProbeLayout, ProbeRace și sondele podului, teraselor și acelor; relieful (creasta, vârful, defileul) e încă schematic — se construiește pe POI. Dreptunghiurile arată cât loc cere fiecare lot de assets, la scară.

Plan · vedere de sus, orientarea lumii din Godot (nord sus, est la stânga) —

granit: piață, trepte, creastă, cornișă podul de frânghie pământ ocru: mal, serpentine defileul (pădure de nori) terasele râul Urubamba traseul autobuzului șina trenului hazard

Profil de elevație · un tur · din curba reală

Urcare pe trepte (B: 0 → 35 m pe ~330 m, 11,5 % măsurat la 0,16), creasta coboară (C: 35 → −5 m), cascada de terase (D: −5 → −20 m), podul plat la −20, malul e fundul lumii (F: −29 m), serpentinele urcă înapoi (G: −29 → 0 pe ~430 m, 9 %) cu 4 ace de rază 13,9 m pe axă. Râul e la −40 m sub creastă, nu la −400: adâncimea se citește prin proximitate.

POI selectat

Alege un POI pe hartă sau un rând din tabel.

Gărzile, înainte de orice decor

ProbeLayout1 985,6 m · rază minimă 9,0 m la 0,40 · pantă maximă 11,5 % la 0,16 · apropiere de sine 21,4 m
ProbeRace150 s, 4 seed-uri, fără decor: 0 repuneri, 0 % offroad, 1,7–2,2 tururi; cu autobuzul pe serpentine: 0 contacte
ProbeMachupodul: 16 / 16 treceri, valul ridică mașina ușoară; ~48 treceri de AI în cursă, 0 căderi
ProbeMachuTeren8 căderi de 2,5 m la rând, 4 mașini: 0 răsturnări; acul de 13 m lasă interiorul liber cu autobuzul de 3,6 m
probe_decorîncă fără decor · țintă ≤ 20 materiale din 38

Ceasurile de hazard tur ~72 s

Reguli care au decis harta

Poza clasică e parbrizul, nu fundalul. Creasta coboară spre nord prin dreptul Casei Paznicului: terasele la −5…−25 m umplu jumătatea de jos a cadrului (63° în jos ajung), iar Huayna Picchu, 30 m la 50 m distanță, iese prin marginea de sus — întreg se vede de la Poarta Soarelui și crește pe coborâre. Toată orientarea pistei e derivată de aici.

Ruina e carosabil, coliziunea e pantă. Treptele trăiesc în mesh și într-un zgomot de ±3 cm pe raycast (custom_step_ranges), nu în corpul de coliziune: 0,00 % viteză pierdută pe 100 m, dar suspensia le simte. Așa ocolim capcana din Ignition (roata cade în orice gol).

Suprafața cu masă, nu hazard cu ceas. Podul nu are fază: două ecuații de arc-amortizor (săgeată, unghi lateral) pe 8 plăci permanente AnimatableBody3D; autobuzul 2,6 ≈ 1,5 m, sportul 0,9 ≈ 0,6 m. Prima suprafață din joc care face masa vizibilă fără contact între mașini.

Acele au raza ≥ 13 m pe axă. La 10 m sportul nu ținea interiorul nici fără autobuz; la 13,9 m interiorul rămâne liber cu autobuzul de 3,6 m care ia acul larg. Contractul lui: te scoate de pe bandă spre exterior (≥ 3 m), nu te oprește.

Fără slot nou. MARBLE_GREY 29 + ROCK_LIGHT 3 fac granitul, LARCH_RUST 27 scoarța de queñual, FLAMINGO_PINK 31 orhideele, CAR_BLUE + CAR_YELLOW trenul. A doua pistă fără asfalt.

Lista de assets —

Materiale: atlas + ~7 clase (inca_stone, inca_steps, terrace_grass, cloud_forest, dirt_road, river_rapids, decal tyre_on_stone) + shader-ul podului (deformare din 2 parametri) + apă + ceață locală (norul) → țintă ≤ 20. Zidul incaș e piesa care se multiplică (150+ piese): sub 300 tri, rosturile în textură, nu în geometrie; terasele sunt teren, nu asset. Un singur hazard nou mare (RopeBridgeHazard); norul, autobuzul, bârnele, lamele, trenul sunt reuse cu parametri.

1 · Planul de referință pentru ChatGPT · captura reală din Godot, adnotată docs/track_briefs/img/machu_picchu_plan.png

Asta se atașează la prompturi, nu planul schematic de mai sus: bucla, terasele, defileul și relieful sunt geometria din Track15.tscn (ortografic, snapshot.gd --track=8 --bus-at=30), literele și cercurile sunt legenda. Diorama generată din ea are aceeași sursă de adevăr ca jocul, deci criticul orb compară așezări identice. Cetatea nu apare în captură (decorul nu e construit încă; se vede doar taluzul teraselor la stânga crestei) — de aceea în prompt cetatea e descrisă în cuvinte, iar planul dă bucla, cotele și relieful. Huayna Picchu (215, −265) e la 45 m în afara cadrului, spre nord; e marcat cu un triunghi la margine.

2 · Prompt pentru inventarul de assets (ChatGPT) · toate piesele într-o singură foaie, cu numele de fișier scrise 

Create a single tall REFERENCE SHEET of low-poly game assets for a toy-car racing track at Machu Picchu, Peru (dry-season morning), in the same style as the attached low-poly diorama: faceted flat-shaded meshes, no fine surface texture, chunky tabletop-miniature proportions, soft baked ambient occlusion, muted grey-and-green colors (~45% saturation) with only three saturated accents (the blue-and-yellow train, the yellow bus, toy cars). Neutral light grey background, one 10 m scale bar per row, every piece LABELED with its exact file name written under it. Rows, top to bottom:

1. rope_bridge.glb — HERO, the most important piece. A 35 m Inca grass-rope suspension bridge (Q'eswachaka): a plank deck 11 m wide on four thick braided straw-colored cables, rope handrails at 1 m, shown SAGGING 1.5 m in the middle under a yellow bus-car with a small red car lifted on the bulge near the end. Beside it bridge_tower_a.glb and bridge_tower_b.glb: two squat mortarless stone anchor towers 5 m high. One single mesh for the deck (it deforms in a shader). Under 3,000 triangles.
2. huayna_picchu.glb — the sharp green peak, 30 m tall, seen from 50 m: three color bands — pale granite crown on top, dark cloud-forest green flank, small grass terraces at the base. Simple silhouette, a few big facets.
3. inti_punku.glb (the Sun Gate: a stone gateway 5 m wide with two small roofless rooms on a ridge shoulder), main_gate.glb (the trapezoid Main Gate: 4 m wide, 5 m tall, a granite door frame narrower at the top), guardhouse.glb (the Guardhouse: three stone walls open on one side with a steep thatched roof in two slopes).
4. sun_temple.glb (the Temple of the Sun: a curved mortarless wall on a bare rock with one small window), intihuatana.glb (the Intihuatana: a carved granite pillar-stone on a small stepped mound), three_windows.glb (the Temple of the Three Windows: one long wall with three trapezoid windows — the silhouette of the Sacred Plaza).
5. inca_bridge_ledge.glb — the Inca Bridge ledge: a 30 m stretch of narrow stone ledge cut into a sheer cliff wall, with a 4 m gap bridged by three loose wooden beams (show the beams both in place and removed).
6. llama.glb — a toy llama 1.7 m tall with a long neck and a stubby body, three color variants (white, sand, dark brown); FOUR poses side by side: Walk, Idle, Graze, Tumble (on its side). Origin at the ground, facing -Z, legs below 0.55 m so a shader can swing them. Under 400 triangles. Next to it condor.glb: an Andean condor perched on a rock, 1.2 m tall sitting, black with a white collar and a red head, shown twice — wings Closed and wings Open (3 m span).
7. consettur_bus.glb (a short chunky yellow-and-white tourist bus 3.6 m wide, 6 m long, big windows, toy proportions) and perurail_train.glb (a blue-and-yellow locomotive plus three carriages with roof windows, 1:1 with the bus scale).
8. CITADEL KIT — one row, same scale: inca_wall_a/b/c.glb (mortarless white-grey granite walls 2–3 m tall with trapezoid niches, straight ends so they chain), inca_stair_a/b.glb (stone stairs set into a terrace wall, 2.5 m rise), inca_house_a/b.glb (small gabled stone houses, one with a thatched roof and one roofless), fountain_basin.glb (a stone fountain basin 1.5 m, water spout on one side), water_channel.glb (a 4 m straight stone water channel), trail_marker.glb (a standing stone with a carved sign), rope_rail.glb (a 4 m rope parapet on wooden posts).
9. CLOUD-FOREST KIT — one row: polylepis_a/b.glb (twisted queñual trees 4 and 7 m tall with peeling red-brown bark and small dark crowns), tree_fern.glb (a 4 m tree fern), bromeliad.glb (a spiky rosette 0.6 m for rock walls), orchid_cluster.glb (a pink orchid cluster 0.4 m — the only saturated plant), moss_boulder_a/b/c.glb (mossy granite boulders 1, 2.5 and 4 m), bamboo_clump.glb (a 5 m clump of river bamboo).
10. STATION KIT — one row: tent_a/b.glb (two small dome tents, orange and green, muted), backpack_pile.glb (a heap of backpacks 1 m).
11. BACKGROUND — one row, own scale bar: gorge_far_wall.glb (the opposite wall of the gorge, 200 m long, cloud forest as bands of green, seen from 200 m), machu_picchu_mountain.glb (the rounded south mountain shoulder, 60 m tall, as a silhouette), cloud_bank.glb (a flat soft white cloud bank 80 m long lying low in a valley).
12. chevron_post.glb — reuse: 1.2 m post with a red-and-white chevron plate (include for completeness).

Colors: granite white-grey #DCD8CE with #A39D8F shadow faces, terrace grass #7E8C4A, cloud-forest dark green #3C5A3A, queñual bark #A34A2C, ochre dirt road #B08A4A, river brown-green #6E7A55 with white rapids #F5F3EE, straw rope and thatch #D9B85C, cloud white #F5F3EE, train blue #2F6DB5 with yellow #E4B93A, bus yellow #E4B93A with white, llama #F5F3EE / #C9A66B / #4A3A2E, condor #1E1B18 with #F5F3EE collar and #C8322B head, orchid pink #E86C95. The sky is NOT part of the sheet.
Atașează imaginea dioramei generate ca referință de stil. Numele de fișier de pe foaie sunt contractul cu docs/asset_briefs/ și cu tools/blender/build_*.py (categoria assets/models/machupicchu/). Convențiile pentru animale: origine la sol, −Z înainte, picioarele sub y = 0,55 m (rig-ul vacii, memoria asset-animat-pipeline: întâi Quaternius). Podul e un singur mesh cu UV-ul pe lungime: deformarea vine din shader, nu din oase.

3 · Prompt pentru dioramă (ChatGPT) 

Create a stylized low-poly tabletop diorama of a toy-car racing track
at Machu Picchu, Peru, on a crisp dry-season morning — a white granite
Inca citadel on a knife-edge ridge, stepped grass terraces, a sharp green
peak at one end, and a deep river gorge with a cloud rising out of it.
Use the attached top-down plan as the layout. IMPORTANT: the plan is a
real render of the track seen straight from above — the loop shape, the
hairpins, the terrace slope and the gorge are MANDATORY and must be kept
exactly (north is up; the loop is driven counter-clockwise, the gorge
always on the car's right along the ridge, the citadel and terraces
inside the loop). The letters, circles and dashed rectangles are only a
legend: A start in the Sacred Plaza, B the Inca Trail steps, C the Sun
Gate and the ridge, D the terrace cascade, E the rope bridge, F the river
bank with the train, G the switchbacks with the bus, H the Inca Bridge
ledge. The citadel itself is not drawn on the plan — build it from the
description below. Do not draw the letters.

STYLE (strict): faceted, flat-shaded low-poly meshes like a Blender
viewport render — no fine surface texture, no painterly brushwork, no
photorealism. Chunky toy proportions: cars are stubby and ~1.3× wider
than real cars; llamas are simplified into big smooth blocks with a few
facets. Soft baked ambient occlusion under every wall, tree and animal.
Muted grey-and-green environment colors (~45% saturation) with only three
saturated accents: the blue-and-yellow train in the gorge, the yellow bus
on the switchbacks, and the toy cars. Lighting: a bright warm sun about
40° above the horizon from the south-west, casting a crisp dark stripe of
shadow under every terrace wall and lighting the white granite almost
white; a clear saturated Andean blue sky, with a soft white cloud bank
lying low in the gorge and one tongue of cloud climbing the cliff toward
the road. Thin white haze in the far distance. Show the diorama on a
thin dark rounded-rectangle table base, from a raised 3/4 view.

THE LAND [!]: the diorama is a narrow saddle ridge with the citadel on
top, a sharp green peak (Huayna Picchu) rising ~30 m just beyond the
north end of the ridge, a taller rounded mountain shoulder at the south
end with a stone gate on it, and steep green cloud-forest walls dropping
on both sides into a gorge with a brown-green river with white rapids at
the bottom, 40 m below the citadel. The inner flank of the ridge is a
staircase of ten grass terraces with white stone retaining walls, and the
citadel — mortarless white granite walls, trapezoid niches, a few
thatched roofs — fills the top of the ridge between the plaza and the
terraces. Twisted red-barked trees, tree ferns and mossy boulders grow on
the slopes.

THE ROUTE — a single closed loop of about 2 km, counter-clockwise, the
gorge on the right along the ridge [!]:
1. Start/finish in the Sacred Plaza (bottom of the plan): a paved
   granite square between mortarless stone walls with trapezoid niches,
   a wall with three trapezoid windows, a carved stone pillar on a small
   mound, two llamas grazing.
2. The Inca Trail up to the Sun Gate (bottom edge, left to right): the
   road leaves the citadel and climbs on wide stone steps along the
   south mountain's flank, the gorge falling away on the right with no
   railing, a short rock tunnel, and a white cloud tongue climbing the
   cliff onto the road.
3. The Sun Gate and the ridge [!] — the biggest feature (right edge,
   bottom to top): a stone gateway with two rooms on the shoulder, a
   condor perched on a rock beside it with wings spread; then the road
   turns 150° and runs down the knife-edge ridge toward the peak,
   drop-offs on both sides, past a small stone house with a thatched
   roof — the whole citadel and its terraces spread out below and ahead
   on the left, the gorge on the right, the peak straight ahead.
4. The terrace cascade (top right): the road zigzags down ten grass
   terraces on ramps set into the white walls; one car is jumping
   straight down the terraces instead; a line of four llamas crosses one
   terrace; a staircase of small stone fountains runs down beside them.
5. The rope bridge [!] — the second biggest feature (top middle): a
   straw-colored grass-rope suspension bridge with a plank deck and rope
   handrails spans a side gorge between two stone towers; it sags deeply
   under a big yellow bus-car in the middle and a small red car near the
   end is lifted on the bulge; the river with white rapids is far below,
   seen between the planks.
6. The river bank (top left): the road dips to the river past a tiny
   station with tents and backpacks; a blue-and-yellow train with roof
   windows runs along the bank on its own track, not crossing the road.
7. The switchbacks (left edge, top to bottom): an ochre dirt road climbs
   the cliff in four hairpins between twisted red-barked trees; a
   yellow-and-white bus is coming down the hairpins toward the cars,
   filling two thirds of the road.
8. The Inca Bridge ledge (bottom left): the road enters a narrow ledge
   cut into the west cliff, crosses a gap bridged by three wooden beams
   (one car jumping it), passes through a trapezoid stone gateway, and
   returns to the plaza with the green peak visible over the citadel.

CARS: 6–8 chunky toy cars in saturated colors (red, blue, yellow, a
white police car, a big red fire truck, a long yellow bus), spread around
the loop, one drifting on the granite plaza. Nothing else on the diorama
is saturated except the train and the bus.
Atașează la prompt planul de referință adnotat (imaginea de la punctul 1, click dreapta → salvează). Brief-ul §9 (v0.1) scria „clockwise”; în convenția Track13/14 bucla din scenă e antiorară cu defileul pe dreapta — promptul de aici e aliniat cu scena. Dacă generatorul pune cetatea în junglă sau vârful ca fundal, reafirmă „white granite on a GREEN RIDGE, the citadel is BELOW the ridge road” și „the peak is 30 m tall, 50 m from the road, NOT a distant mountain”.
